input.quote: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 restricts us from participating in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or "products substantially similar" — an undefined field-of-use restriction on our own business that reaches well beyond the branded Site (the only carve-out, in 6.2, is closeout merchandise). We narrowed it to a self-contained "Deerskin"-branded consumer site during the term, with carve-outs for our other channels, internal development and acquisitions.

input.quote: HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet
input.rationale: Section 6 grants HDI exclusivity over our branded consumer web channel for the full (auto-renewing) term with no performance-based exit — the only escape is the 70-day launch failure right in Section 1.6 or a 90-day termination that triggers a Termination Payment. We added automatic termination of the exclusivity, and freedom to procure from third parties, if HDI misses the launch date or fails to operate the Site and does not cure within 30 days. HDI's reciprocal restraint in Section 6.3 benefits us and is unchanged.
